description: This file defines configuration options for stream cache eviction and stream statistics within the Orleans framework, including properties for cache timing and statistics monitoring intervals.

classes.name: StreamCacheEvictionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream cache eviction, including timing parameters for message and metadata cache durations.

classes.name: StreamStatisticOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream statistics, primarily the interval for statistic monitoring.

methods.name: TimeSpan.FromMinutes
methods.description: Creates a TimeSpan representing the specified number of minutes.

methods.name: DefaultDataMinTimeInCache.Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies a TimeSpan by a factor to produce a new TimeSpan, used here to set default metadata cache duration.
